rows.question: What is photometrically observed Galaxy
rows.pred_sql:
WITH spec_matched AS (
  SELECT
    s.specobjid,
    s.bestobjid,
    s.class,
    s.subclass
  FROM specobj s
),
gals AS (
  -- union of specobjids coming from galspecline and spplines
  SELECT specobjid FROM galspecline
  UNION
  SELECT specobjid FROM spplines
)
SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.run,
  p.rerun,
  p.field,
  p.mode,
  p.type,
  p.clean,
  p.flags,
  p.rowc,
  p.colc,
  p.cmodelmag_u,
  p.cmodelmag_g,
  p.cmodelmag_r,
  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  p.b,
  p.l,
  p.extinction_r,
  p.mjd,
  p.u,
  p.g,
  p.r,
  p.i,
  p.z,
  s.specobjid,
  s.class,
  s.subclass
FROM photoobj p
LEFT JOIN spec_matched s
  ON p.objid = s.bestobjid
LEFT JOIN gals g
  ON (s.specobjid = g.specobjid)
WHERE
  -- include if there is a spectroscopic match that is a galaxy by class,
  -- or if the photo objid appears in the gals/spplines lists,
  -- or if there is any specobj match (specobjid IS NOT NULL)
  (
    (s.specobjid IS NOT NULL AND s.class ILIKE '%GALAXY%')
    OR (g.specobjid IS NOT NULL)
    OR (s.specobjid IS NOT NULL)
    OR p.objid IN (SELECT specobjid FROM galspecline)
    OR p.objid IN (SELECT specobjid FROM spplines)
  )

rows.question: Find Galaxy that are photometrically observable
rows.pred_sql:
WITH spec_galaxies AS (
  SELECT
    s.specobjid,
    s.class     AS spec_class,
    s.subclass  AS spec_subclass,
    s.ra        AS spec_ra,
    s.dec       AS spec_dec,
    s.z         AS spec_z,
    s.bestobjid
  FROM specobj s
  WHERE s.class = 'GALAXY'
),
-- restrict candidate photoobjs to only those that could match (bestobjid or specobjid),
-- and include their key columns so joins remain possible
candidate_photos AS (
  SELECT p.*
  FROM photoobj p
  JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT bestobjid AS id FROM spec_galaxies WHERE bestobjid IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT specobjid::bigint AS id FROM spec_galaxies WHERE specobjid IS NOT NULL
  ) ids ON p.objid = ids.id
),
-- choose a single photoobj per spectrum by preferring bestobjid match, else matching specobjid, then smallest objid
spec_photo_link AS (
  SELECT
    g.specobjid,
    g.spec_class,
    g.spec_subclass,
    g.spec_ra,
    g.spec_dec,
    g.spec_z,
    p.objid     AS photo_objid,
    p.run       AS photo_run,
    p.rerun     AS photo_rerun,
    p.field     AS photo_field,
    p.type      AS photo_type,
    p.clean     AS photo_clean,
    p.ra        AS photo_ra,
    p.dec       AS photo_dec,
    p.u         AS photo_u,
    p.g         AS photo_g,
    p.r         AS photo_r,
    p.i         AS photo_i,
    p.z         AS photo_z,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY g.specobjid
      ORDER BY
        (CASE WHEN p.objid = g.bestobjid THEN 0 WHEN p.objid = g.specobjid::bigint THEN 1 ELSE 2 END),
        p.objid
    ) AS rn
  FROM spec_galaxies g
  LEFT JOIN candidate_photos p
    ON p.objid = g.bestobjid
    OR p.objid = g.specobjid::bigint
)
SELECT
  spl.specobjid,
  spl.spec_class  AS class,
  spl.spec_subclass AS subclass,
  spl.spec_ra     AS ra,
  spl.spec_dec    AS dec,
  spl.spec_z      AS z,
  spl.photo_objid,
  spl.photo_run,
  spl.photo_rerun,
  spl.photo_field,
  spl.photo_type,
  spl.photo_clean,
  spl.photo_ra,
  spl.photo_dec,
  spl.photo_u,
  spl.photo_g,
  spl.photo_r,
  spl.photo_i,
  spl.photo_z
FROM spec_photo_link spl
WHERE spl.rn = 1
  AND spl.photo_objid IS NOT NULL
  AND spl.photo_ra IS NOT NULL
  AND spl.photo_dec IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY spl.specobjid ASC, spl.photo_objid ASC

  SELECT
    p.objid AS objid,
    p.ra,
    p.dec,
    p.u,
    p.g,
    p.r,
    p.i,
    p.z,
    n.objid AS neighbor_pair_objid,
    n.neighborobjid AS neighborobjid,
    n.distance
  FROM photoobj p

    ON n.objid = p.objid OR n.neighborobjid = p.objid

  objid,
  ra,
  dec,
  u,
  g,
  r,

FROM photo_with_neighbors

  AND u IS NOT NULL

  AND r IS NOT NULL
